name: corrcoef_pvalues
comment: corrcoef second output P (two-sided p-values) vs MATLAB R2025b. Bug fixed 2026-05-30: corrcoef was 1-output only. P(i,j)=2*tcdf(-|t|,n-2) with t=r*sqrt((n-2)/(1-r^2)); diagonal=1. corrcoef([1 2 3 4]',[2 4 5 9]') -> R(1,2)=0.96476382, P(1,2)=0.035236179 (symmetric, p11=1). Matrix corrcoef -> Pm(1,2)=0.366717, Pm(1,3)=0.49324, Pm(2,3)=0.126523. namespace=stats (descriptive).
